title: ATM Cancel Button Reel - Storyboard (6 shots x 8s, Google Flow)
purpose: Existing KMH video storyboard prompt stored in the AI Prompt Library. Pilot use is controlled record creation and QA planning; publication remains blocked pending behavior and factual review.
prompt_text: SHOT 1 (0-8s): Card insert close-up, cinematic. Dialogue: "ATM ကနေ ငွေထုတ်ပြီးတိုင်း Cancel ခလုတ်ကို မနှိပ်ဘူးဆိုရင် အန္တရာယ်ရှိနိုင်တယ်" Ambient: ATM beep || SHOT 2 (8-16s): Walking away, screen still lit. Dialogue: "အများစုက session ချက်ချင်း မပိတ်ဘူး" Ambient: footsteps || SHOT 3 (16-24s): Active session close-up, blurred figure approaching. Dialogue: "Short window အတွင်းမှာ session continue လုပ်နိုင်တယ်" Ambient: suspense tone || SHOT 4 (24-32s): Crowded ATM booth. Dialogue: "Crowded ATM တွေမှာ ပိုဖြစ်တတ်တယ်" Ambient: crowd murmur || SHOT 5 (32-40s): Pressing Cancel, screen resets. Dialogue: "Cancel နှိပ်ပါ၊ home screen ပြန်ရောက်အောင် စောင့်ပါ" Ambient: button click, chime || SHOT 6 (40-48s): Share prompt, smiling. Dialogue: "Save ထားပြီး Share ပေးပါ" Ambient: upbeat tone

required: Use as the source storyboard prompt without silently editing the original text.
notes: Original record does not declare structured input variables; unknown input parameters remain unspecified.

criteria: Each shot is assigned an 8-second interval spanning 00:00–00:48.
Preserve the supplied Burmese dialogue and shot order unless a separately reviewed revision is authorized.
Represent the listed ambient sound cues in the corresponding shots.
Factual claim about ATM sessions remaining active must be reviewed against a reliable source before public release.
not_guaranteed: Visual quality, actual generation output, and factual accuracy have not been behavior-tested.

target_model_or_tool: Google Flow (as recorded in original Notion AI Prompt Library; exact model/version not recorded)
change_summary: Initial controlled draft record created from an existing Notion AI Prompt Library entry; source prompt text preserved verbatim as retrieved. No behavior changes made.

test_cases.expected_criteria: Check six ordered shots, eight seconds per shot, continuous 00:00–00:48 coverage, and preservation of original dialogue and ambient cues.
Check no missing, overlapping, or out-of-order time ranges; flag any output that changes Burmese dialogue or omits sound cues.
Do not approve for public release if the ATM-session safety claims lack reliable factual support or if output invents additional safety claims.

test_evidence.reviewer_note: Record creation only. No model/tool behavior execution performed; no actual output inspected.
